race.comment: GODDESS KAY (7) is a Frankel filly on debut for the Corstens & Larkin yard who has looked very talented at the jumpouts, winning her latest here by a huge margin in fast time. Showed plenty of speed there and should be ready to go. SOLDI (4) is one with (winning) experience, taking out the Debutante Stakes at Caulfield. Beat Royal Press there who was a drifter but ran a game 2nd on Derby Day. SHE'S SUPREME (5) comes through the G3 Gimcrack Stakes at Randwick where she started single figures and ran third. Speedy type who has trialled since and might have a bit more race craft than most of these. JACQUETS OFF (8) is a Jacquinot filly on debut for the Simon Zahra yard who won a recent jumpout impressively and the wide draws have been the place to be all week. THE CHANCER (3) is a Star Witness gelding worth respecting.
